neighbours.label: the token ' almost' (approximation adverb before a quantity, adverb or universal)
fire: The old bridge was almost completely hidden by the fog that morning.
By the end of the season the team had won almost every home game.
Our neighbour's cat sleeps almost all day on the warm windowsill.
The museum receives almost two million visitors in a normal year.
When the train finally arrived, the platform was almost empty.
She had almost forgotten the password by the time she needed it.
These small birds spend almost their entire lives over open water.
The recipe takes almost an hour, most of it waiting for the dough.
quiet: The old bridge was nearly hidden by the fog that morning.
By the end of the season the team had won most of its home games.
Our neighbour's cat sleeps through the day on the warm windowsill.
The museum receives roughly two million visitors in a normal year.
When the train finally arrived, the platform was quiet and cold.
She had nearly forgotten the password by the time she needed it.
These small birds spend much of their lives over open water.
The recipe takes about an hour, most of it waiting for the dough.

notes: Card: ' almost' is the peak token of 25 of the top 32. Near misses use 'nearly', 'roughly', 'about' to separate the word from the meaning.
